monitoring: eGFR at least annually in all patients taking metformin.

rules.headline: Metformin is contraindicated when eGFR is below 30 mL/min/1.73 m²
rules.rationale: FDA labeling states metformin is contraindicated at eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m²; discontinue if eGFR falls below 30.

monitoring: eGFR at least annually; assess benefit/risk if eGFR falls below 45.
limitations: Applies to NEW starts. For patients already taking metformin the label advises a benefit–risk assessment.

alternatives.text: No specific alternative is encoded; see the cited source.

rules.headline: Starting metformin is not recommended when eGFR is 30–45 mL/min/1.73 m²
rules.rationale: FDA labeling states starting metformin at eGFR 30–45 is not recommended; if eGFR falls below 45 in a current patient, benefits and risks of continuing should be assessed.
